0.Note: Qualifying rained out, field set by the rulebook

1.Note: #45 leads the field to green on the outside, #5 inside.  #5 gets a push from #11 and clears for the lead in turn 1.  #5 blocks both lanes on the backstretch but #11 gets a push from #19 and surges into the lead by turn 3 on the inside.

2.Note: Third lane begins to form near 17th led by #3, who then surges up to 7th by turn 4.

3.Note: #19 looks outside of #11 off turn 2, #3 makes it a three-wide battle for the lead by turn 3.

4.Note: This is the first time Richard Childress Racing has led in Cup since the Daytona 500

5.Note: Bottom lane has eroded with just #11 and #54 running there, causing #54 to use a great deal of throttle.  #19 moves to the outside lane to block #3.

8.Note: Bottom line has somewhat reformed led by #11, #54, #5 and #24.  #19 and #11 battle side-by-side for the lead.

10.Note: #66 has used the middle lane to surge into the lead.  He started the race 38th

14.Note: #66 continues to lead the field with #19 leading the middle lane and #51 leading the outside lane.

15.Note: Outside lane has begun to fade, with the top 6 cars having broken away.  #66 leads ahead of #11 and #19 battling for 2nd

17.Note: Top 8 cars run single file at the front of the field led by #66, #11 and #19

18.Note: #66 goes high and fades, #11 now leads

21.Note: Most of the field is back to using near full throttle.  #11 continues to lead the top 7 in single file formation

23.Note: #66, running 11th, has his hood buffering badly

27.Note: The field has mostly gotten single file as the majority of the field gets closer to running near full throttle

35.Note: Outside lane has begun to reform led by #24 near 15th as many teams discuss pitting soon.

41.Note: #11, #19, #54, #42, #8, #16, #51, #3 all pit.  #19 overshoots his pit stall, hits a crew member and has to back up.  #11 too fast entering pit road. #19 safety violation

42.Note: #66, #44 pit.  #66 penalized for pit road speeding

47.Note: #60, #6, #21, #2, #34, #22, #23, #4, #17, #88, #20, #41, #38, #12, #43 all pit.  #2 misses his pit stall and has to go through the pits.

48.Note: #45, #7, #35, #2 pit.  #35 too fast entering, #38 uncontrolled tire

49.Note: As the green flag pit cycle comes to an end, #54 now leads ahead of #42 and #8

57.Note: Top 5 run single file led by #54, #42, #8 and #16

60.Note: #54 has caught #11 but does not lap him.  #71 has charged in the middle lane up to battle #42 for 2nd.

61.Note: #71 looks outside #54 to battle for the lead

62.Note: #19 rallies on the outside lane and passes #54 to get back on the lead lap.  Both #11 and #19 now lead the pack in front of leader #54 and are the last two cars on the lead lap

65.Note: Outside lane has eroded with #54 running 1st but is behind teammates #11 and #19 in the lead pack.  #3 runs 2nd ahead of #51

71.Note: 19 cars on the lead lap have not pit a 2nd time during this stage.  #20 leads ahead of #24 and #97

77.Note: #19 continues to run at the tail of the lead lap, just in front of teammate/race leader #20

82.Note: #35, #38, #2 pit.  #20 catches #11 and #54 but does not lap either one.  #19 gets shuffled out of line and falls one lap down.  #35 too fast entering

95.Note: ##60 continues to lead the main pack of cars that pit only once.

97.Note: #6 leads an outside lane battling for 2nd alongside #17.

98.Note: #6 looks outside #60 to battle for the lead before fading by turn 3.  #60 wins stage 1 followed by #6, #22, #17 and #12.

99.Note: #45 pits before pit road is open

101.Note: All lead lap cars pit.  #23 gets off pit road first after taking fuel only followed by #1 and #22.

105.Note: Restart: #23 leads from the outside, #1 inside.  #1 gets a push from #41 to briefly move into the lead before #23 surges back on the backstretch.  #1 pulls even in turns 3-4.

107.Note: #23 clears #1 for the lead, but #1 then shoots to the middle lane in front of #22 and takes the lead back in the tri-oval.

108.Note: #1 drops to the inside lane with #22 and #12 leading the middle lane.  A 3rd lane up top led by #8 near 10th has formed but is slowly fading.

110.Note: #1 continues to lead as the top 4 run single file.  #41 leads a resurgent top/3rd lane near 5th

111.Note: #22 looks outside #1 and takes the lead with #12 behind him in 2nd

112.Note: As #22 and #12 lead the middle lane, both the top (led by #41) and bottom (led by #1) lanes charge back

114.Note: #23 and #1 shuffle #22 back to 7th in the trioval as the field stacks up 4 wide

115.Note: Caution:  As the field comes to the end of the backstretch, #23 gets bumped in front of the field and spins, triggering a multi-car crash.  Cars involved include:  #2, #3, #5, #6, #7, #8, #11, #12, #19, #21, #22, #23, #24, #33, #41, #42, #43, #44, #45, #51, #54, #66, #71, #77, #88, #97

117.Note: All lead lap cars except #20 pit.  #1 gets off pit road first followed by #17 and #60

118.Note: #88 penalized one lap for moving under red flag conditions

122.Note: Restart:  #20 leads from the outside, #1 inside.  Both remain side-by-side the entire lap

123.Note: #1 clears for the lead in the tri-oval

124.Note: Caution:  #54 cuts a right front tire in turn 4 and collects #71 as both hit the outside wall.

130.Note: Restart: #1 leads from the inside, #20 outside.  #1 gets a push from #34 to clear for the lead by turn 1, then he blocks a run by #20 on the backstretch.  #17 dives under #20 to battle for 2nd off turn 4

134.Note: #1 and #20 continue to battle for the lead as the field runs entirely two-by-two

135.Note: #1 gets a push to clear #20 for the lead off turn 2 but #20 fights back in turn 4

137.Note: #20 and #47 clear the #1 on the backstretch but #1 fights back to get alongside #47 by turn 3.

138.Note: #1 clears for the lead by turn 3 but #20 fights back in the tri-oval

143.Note: #20 clears for the lead by turn 1 but #1 gets underneath at the end of the backstretch.  #1 edges ahead by turn 4.  #1 wins stage 2 followed by #20, #17, #47 and #34

146.Note: All lead lap cars pit.  #17 gets off pit road first followed by #48 and #77.  #20 comes off pit road in 14th as he needed to take more fuel during his stop.  #97 too fast on pit road

151.Note: Restart: #17 leads from the outside, #48 inside.  #17 clears for the lead by turn 1 with #77 clearing for 2nd off turn 2.   Both drop down in front of #48 who runs 3rd, #77 looks outside #17 for the lead off turn 4

153.Note: #17 clears for the lead briefly before #77 fights back in the tri-oval

154.Note: #77 clears for the lead in the tri-oval

160.Note: #77 and #17 continue to run side-by-side for the lead and exchanging who leads at the line.  #43 helps push #77 on the outside, #48 helps push #17 on the inside

161.Note: Caution: #45 cuts a tire in turn 2 running 15th and hits the wall.

167.Note: Restart: #17 leads from the outside, #77 inside.  #77 gets a push from #48 and both clear the #17.  #17 fights back and gets a push from #43 to battle alongside #48 for 2nd.

168.Note: #17 clears #77 for the lead on the backstretch but #77 fights back.  #42 comes to pit road with a potential flat tire

170.Note: #77 looks outside #43 for 2nd and clears in the tri-oval

172.Note: #77 looks outside #17 in turn 1 to battle for the lead.  #77 clears #17 on the backstretch after a push from #47 as the field laps #42 in turns 3-4.

176.Note: #17 and #77 continue to battle side-by-side for the lead as the field runs in two-by-two formation

181.Note: #77 and #43 touch battling for 2nd off turn 4, causing #43 to spin into the infield.

182.Note: Caution: #43 is stuck in the infield grass

186.Note: Restart: #17 leads from the outside, #77 inside. #77 edges ahead with a push from #48 before #17 fights back on the backstretch.

187.Note: #77 clears for the lead entering turn 3 as #17 and #48 battle for 2nd.  #17 fights back in the tri-oval

188.Note: #77 gets the win as #3, #20, #51, #20, #97 wreck behind him
